notes.title: It's Official: Legacy of Sin: Ill-Boding Launches on May 12th!
notes.content:
It's Official: Legacy of Sin: Ill-Boding Launches on May 12th!
We have some exciting news to share — Legacy of Sin: Ill-Boding will officially launch on May 12th! 

To celebrate this major milestone, check out our brand-new RDA Trailer on YouTube and prepare yourself to step into a dark, morally complex world of strategy and survival.
Top 3 Features You’ll Experience

Lead powerful factions in a war-torn world driven by political intrigue and betrayal
Build, manage, and defend your stronghold in a persistent, evolving map
 Choices matter: decisions made in your campaign have real consequences on the battlefield
 Help us by adding the game to your Wishlist and following our page on Steam!
 It’s the best way to support our small indie team and make sure you don’t miss the launch.

Watch the RDA Trailer Now
[previewyoutube=5Unk6QyNsnE;full][/previewyoutube]
Visit the Steam Store Page
Join our Discord Community 
 Follow us on socials @AbsolutePowerGameStudio
Thank you for all the support so far. This game has been a long journey of passion and persistence, and we can't wait to share it with you. Let the countdown begin!

Don’t forget to wishlist the game and join our community to be notified the moment the battle begins!

notes.title: Legacy of Sin blood oath Improvements
notes.content:
We're releasing a new update today that fixes bugs, improves gameplay and translates the game into several other languages! The update is now live for all players! Once again, a huge thanks to everybody who joined us and sent in feedback and suggestions. Your feedback is very important for us to adjust the game and improve! If you like the game leave a positive review on the steam page, Thanks!

The update has redone the game mechanics, that are now much more responsive and intuitive, allowing for a much more pleasant gaming experience for everyone.

Legacy of Sin the Father Sacrifice was our first game, we learned a lot and will use all the lessons learned to make blood oath the best game possible. We hope to have the opportunity to work with more creative and original games, the idea of making generic clones of popular games just to make money doesn't appeal to us. Thanks everyone who supported the project hope to see you again.

Thanks for the feedback and comments, thanks for playing!
